archimate-viewer.js is Atlas's pre-built ArchiMate canvas bundle: a read-only
viewer, and the authoring behaviour it loads on top when the caller may edit
(ADR-0189 §2).

It contains:

  - diagram-js@15.26.0
  - the Atlas-owned Open Group ArchiMate Model Exchange parser, renderer, and
    editing rules in src/index.js

The canvas never creates an element or a relationship itself. Both are written by
the server, which owns the document and the authoring subset, and the view is
re-read — so there is never a shape on screen the document does not have. The
canvas is handed the subset's relationship matrix so a menu offers only what the
write path will accept.

The editing modules (modeling, move, resize, outline, rules) are part of the
bundle whether or not a given canvas loads them, which is what doubled its size
when authoring arrived. They are instantiated only for an editable canvas, so a
reader's diagram carries no modeling behaviour — but the code ships either way,
because a single buildless bundle is the whole point of vendoring it (ADR-0012).

diagram-js and its bundled dependencies are MIT licensed (see LICENSE). The
Atlas parser and renderer remain part of Atlas. Only the output is loaded at
runtime: Atlas remains a single, buildless, offline-capable binary.

Do not edit archimate-viewer.js by hand. To rebuild:

  npm install --no-save --no-package-lock diagram-js@15.26.0 esbuild@0.25.9
  npx esbuild api/web/vendor/archimate/src/index.js --bundle --format=iife \
    --global-name=AtlasArchiMate --minify --legal-comments=none \
    --outfile=api/web/vendor/archimate/archimate-viewer.js
  cp node_modules/diagram-js/assets/diagram-js.css \
    api/web/vendor/archimate/diagram-js.css
